name: @vismay/club-marks
description: toClubMark(): the football-seasons club mark — a crest-family shape (classified from the real crest, which never appears in the output) filled with the home-kit pattern, with a 3-letter code — plus the six accessibility checks, the print-palette snap and dot/token/hero SVG renders. ./types, ./palette, ./color, ./render, ./checks and ./codes are client-safe; the root export needs sharp (Node only).
